parameters.query:
SELECT t.code, t.category, t.title, t.status, t.priority,
       t.assigned_team, e.full_name AS employee_name,
       t.created_at::text, t.updated_at::text
FROM tickets t
JOIN employees e ON e.id = t.employee_id
WHERE t.workspace_id = '{{ $json.workspace_id }}'::uuid
  AND ('{{ $json.access_role }}' = 'hr' OR t.employee_id = '{{ $json.employee_id }}'::uuid)
  {{ $json.filter_code ? "AND t.code = '" + $json.filter_code + "'" : '' }}
ORDER BY t.id DESC LIMIT 50

INSERT INTO tool_calls
  (workspace_id, employee_id, tool_name, input, output, status, error, latency_ms)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json._lws }}'::uuid,
  {{ $json._lemp ? "'" + $json._lemp + "'" : 'NULL' }}::uuid,
  '{{ $json._ltool }}',
  '{{ $json._lin }}'::jsonb,
  {{ $json._lout ? "'" + $json._lout + "'" : 'NULL' }}::jsonb,
  '{{ $json._lst }}',
  {{ $json._lerr ? "'" + $json._lerr + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json._llat }}::integer
)
RETURNING id

INSERT INTO tool_calls
  (workspace_id, employee_id, tool_name, input, output, status, error, latency_ms)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json._lws }}'::uuid,

  '{{ $json._ltool }}',

  {{ $json._lout ? "'" + $json._lout + "'" : 'NULL' }}::jsonb,
  '{{ $json._lst }}',
  {{ $json._lerr ? "'" + $json._lerr + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json._llat }}::integer
)
RETURNING id
